referenceBehavior: FileNode discovers physical quoted includes and resolves pack-relative paths. IncludeGraph detects cycles before all other preprocessing; guards do not hide cycles. IncludeProcessor recursively inserts included lines.
implementationScope: Explicit local ZIP/folder to owned text snapshot to native virtual include resolution and existing material preparation. Source IDs/#line are this adapter's diagnostic mapping, not a claim of identical Iris source IDs.
subset: Classic stored/deflated single-disk ZIP with validated local/central records and signed/unsigned data descriptors; no extraction. Folder identities rechecked around reads; no filesystem-wide locking claim. Source text is UTF-8 with optional initial BOM normalized; canonical ASCII source paths. Quoted canonical #include lines; root-relative and in-root parent resolution; all dependencies before conditions; repeated includes retained.
unsupported: archive path/case/file-parent aliases, symlinks, hard links and special files
unsupported source extensions or non-ASCII source paths
includes inside block comments or inline-comment-prefixed directives
GLSL macro expansion, translation, production recipe or automatic activation
